method.source: regular-season box scores in data/actuals (season_lines.totals' rules, per game), DNPs excluded
method.usage: 100 x (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV) x (team minutes / 5) / (minutes x team (FGA + 0.44 FTA + TOV)), pooled over the games
method.role: starter = started every game; bench = none; mixed otherwise (the box score's starter flag)
method.not_a_projection: the season line stays the per-game line; minutes have no preseason expectation in the pool CSV, so the trend is within-season only
